name: Lead magnet cover
oneLiner: a real-looking printed book (laminated cover in the brand colours, page block, spine) swings in on its spine beside the speaker and settles turned toward them, a big caption and a glass 'link in bio' pill set under it, then a round sticker slaps onto the cover corner
say: when the speaker offers the free thing ('I put all of this in a free guide, link in bio'): cut it in on 'free guide', the sticker lands on 'free'; cover takes a real cover image if there is one
